paper_id: TuneComp_ Joint Fine-tuning and Compression for Large Foundation Models
title: TuneComp: Joint Fine-tuning and Compression for Large Foundation Models
motivation: Sequential fine-tuning then compression creates oversized intermediate model and sacrifices performance
problem_framing: Jointly optimize fine-tuning and compression via progressive knowledge distillation to pruned low-rank structure
key_insight: Integrating fine-tuning with compression preserves task-relevant information that sequential approaches discard
method_signature: Parallel teacher-student branches with cosine decay blending, activation-aware SVD init, and pruning during distillation
evaluation_criteria: Classification accuracy vs compression rate (parameter count) trade-off on ViT transfer learning
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Distill-only without fine-tuning yields poor accuracy (<40%); heavy pruning (≥60%) degrades trade-off
evidence_for_taste: may not have a better trade-off
thinking_moves: 把顺序流程合并为单次优化以保留中间信息
从PC-LoRA固定系数改为余弦退火动态调整混合比例
把层间正则化从常数改为迭代衰减以平衡引导与适应
把激活统计信息融入SVD初始化以优化近似精度
